title: Louisville goalkeeper Cate Cantu named to U-18/U-19 national camp roster
text:
← Back to the wire
Sports
Louisville goalkeeper Cate Cantu named to U-18/U-19 national camp roster
Cate Cantu, a freshman goalkeeper at Louisville, was named to the U.S. Under-18/Under-19 National Camp Roster for an October training session in Florida. She is one of only four college players selected and has already made several appearances for her university team.
University of Louisville freshman goalkeeper Cate Cantu has been named to the 2026 U.S. Under-18, Under-19 October Domestic Camp Roster that will meet from October 3 through 10 for a training camp in West Palm Beach, Florida, according to an Oct. 1 announcement.
The roster includes players from both the U-18 and U-19 national teams. All players invited to the camp were born in either 2008 or 2009 and are eligible for the team that will attempt to qualify for the 2028 FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup.
Cantu is one of four college players selected for the roster, with fifteen others coming from youth clubs. This marks her third selection to a youth national team in 2026.
The Pennsylvania native has appeared in four matches for Louisville this season, totaling just over 140 minutes on the field. She has made two saves during her time with the Cardinals, recording a .500 save percentage.
Cantu's continued presence on youth national teams highlights her ongoing development as a collegiate athlete.
